GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 040 (26 Dec 45) CE
(SCAPIN - 501)
26 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Operation of Japanese Hydrographic Department.
1. The Japanese Hydrographic Department is authorized to carry on its normal peace-time functions subject to the restrictions which follows:
a. All future publication of the Department will be unrestricted.
b. Classified Charts of other nations will not be reproduced by the Japanese.
c. The Department will adopt United States Hydrographic Office conventional symbols upon their charts, and contain English translations of sa▲ent titles and hydrographic information. Soundings may continue to be shown in meters.
2. Required surveys of Japanese waters will be authorized upon application to this headquarters.
3. The Japanese Hydrographic Department will furnish the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers 200 English text copies of each weekly Notice to Mariners.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
